BiblicalUsage: Kallai is a priest named once. He stands in the list of the priests in the days of Joiakim: of Sallai, Kallai.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the single line as his record, and the record is enough, because God counts the priests by name.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
